name: Frank
text: "I was struggling with serious pain and weakness in my left knee — simple things like walking up stairs were tough, and I couldn't do squats anymore without pain. Dr. Leslie Garcia designed a plan that focused on rebuilding strength and control. Now I'm building back better every workout and able to do squats pain free. If you're struggling with any type of body pain, come see Dr. Leslie Garcia — they will make you feel like family."

name: David Zamostny
text: "You know right away when you find someone that actually cares about helping you improve versus someone who just follows old methodologies. Dr. Gomez really understands that not all injuries are the same and won't offer a cookie-cutter program. She even designed a custom workout program for me on the days I didn't have therapy. She helped me feel comfortable in my body again and regain confidence in moving without the fear of pain and re-injury. I can't thank her enough."

name: Jewels Flores
text: "I came in with back pain that was really affecting my daily life, and now I'm feeling so much stronger and completely pain-free. Gina was very knowledgeable, supportive, and truly took the time to make sure I understood my exercises and progress. Everyone in the clinic is friendly and welcoming, which made every visit something I actually looked forward to. I'm so grateful for the care I received — I highly recommend them!"

name: Morgan Raen
text: "My daughter was consistently measuring up on her scoliosis Cobb angle for more than a year. Once she started Physical Therapy with Powerhouse, her scan came back considerably lower and she avoided being braced. We are so happy with the results and the custom therapy treatments developed for her. We strongly recommend Powerhouse Physical Therapy for any patient suffering from scoliosis."

name: O.G.
text: "Dr. Leslie addressed my golfer's elbow with a lot of attention to detail. She allowed me to provide all the examples I could think of that exacerbated pain. The approach involved multiple plans of attack with future-proof strategies to avoid the injury coming back. I appreciate Dr. Leslie also providing digital documentation of what we discussed in our sessions, so I have a catalog of the processes and methods I needed to get back to 100%. Definitely recommend Powerhouse!"

name: Jordana Maciel
text: "I had an amazing experience with Sandra at Powerhouse PT! She is incredibly knowledgeable and attentive, and thanks to her expertise, my shoulder has improved in ways I never thought possible. I can now move and perform tasks that I struggled with for years. Sandra’s personalized approach and dedication truly made a difference in my recovery. I’m beyond grateful for her help and highly recommend her to anyone looking for an exceptional physical therapist!

name: Andrea Rogerio
text: "Dr. Sandra and Gina did a great job in helping Eva get back to the hustle and bustle of athletics with much less back pain and greater awareness of proper body mechanics, posture, and improved strength."

name: Mikey Casso
text: "Before starting my appointments, I was very concerned with my form while running. I would get injured often and couldn't maintain consistent training. After a few weeks I noticed I got a lot stronger and my overall running improved tremendously — I even hit multiple personal records throughout my season. I highly recommend Powerhouse because every trainer is extremely attentive and driven into fixing any issues you may have."
